test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 11 Nov 2021 Shift 1
subject: general
question:
**Select the correct passive voice of the given sentence. **

They switched off lights in memory of the martyrs.

options.text: Lights were being switched off in memory of the martyrs by them.
Lights had been switched off in memory of the martyrs by them.
Lights have been switched off in memory of the martyrs by them.
Lights were switched off by them in memory of the martyrs

solution:
The correct answer is: **Lights were switched off by them in memory of the martyrs**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Active Voice describes a sentence where the subject performs the action stated by the verb. While in the Passive Voice subject is acted upon by the verb.
 
• The structure of active voice = Subject + Verb + Object__
 
• The structure of passive Voice = __Object + modal verb + verb (3rd form) + by + Subject__
 
• Rules of Conversion from Active to Passive Voice:
 
 
• Identify the subject, the verb, and the object.
 
• Change the object into the subject.
 
• Change the verb into the past participle of the verb.
 
• Change the subject into an object.
 
 

Thus the passive voice will be: *Lights were switched off by them in memory of the martyrs*
